name: Infra cross-repo: repo.provider and exports
description: Milestone 7. repo.provider { url, ref, path? }: sparse partial clone via git into a cache under LOCALAPPDATA/repo-infra/repos/<hash>, reference-mode evaluation (lookups by the other project's markers, plays don't run), read returned Exports, lazy blob fetch for files used by imported roles. Exported resources get the exported marker. See docs infra-cli/envs-and-repos.
